_: Single source of the model constants. streetKnownBit = listings flags bit set when the portal itself confirms a street (otodom street name at radius 0 or geocoded from the street index, gratka street, domiporta hasStreet, adresowo geoPrecision >= 3); merge_listings.py demotes a pin shared by >= stackedPin ads to prec 2 only for rows without it, and hood medians take at most stackedPin - 1 rows per identical 5-decimal pin. Read by web/app.js + web/worker.js (bundled by scripts/build.mjs) and by api/engine.py + mcp_server/core.py. linkHosts = portals whose zobacz-na links passed pipeline/verify/linkcheck.py; pipeline/merge_listings.py keeps only those urls. feeKnownBit = the listings flags bit set when the price is the full monthly cost (rent + czynsz administracyjny); only such rows with prec < 2 enter medians (web/rent.js, mcp_server/core.py, api/queries.py). walk/bike: network speed (m/min) and circuity = network / straight-line distance by straight-line distance (m), linear between the points, flat beyond the ends, measured on the OSM walk and bike graphs (2026-10-25: 300 random origins, up to 40 targets per distance band, medians, plus a 27 m door and stop snap); bike circuity scaled x0.946 on 2026-10-28 for the tag-based bike speeds (routed minutes median 0.946 of the old flat-250 graph); bike.speeds = routed edge speed in m/min by OSM tag class (pipeline/walk/build_graph.py bike_speed: infra = cycleway, bicycle=designated or a cycleway lane/track on the road; calm = residential, living_street, service, unclassified; busy = primary/secondary/tertiary/trunk without bike infra, same as calm; track = unpaved track; path = path/pedestrian/bridleway without bicycle=designated); minutes = d * circuity(d) / mPerMin (web/engine.js netMin, api/engine.py net_min). plausibleArea = merge_listings.py turns an area below max(minM2, minM2PerRoom * rooms) or a price per m2 above maxPricePerM2 into -1 (unknown); the row and its price stay; a row under minListedPricePerM2 PLN per m2 (the price of one room in a big flat) is dropped and counted as notFlat. medianPlausible = merge_listings.py clears the feeKnown bit (so the row leaves every median, stays listed) of a row with a known area whose price per m2 is below minPricePerM2 or whose area is above maxAreaForMedian, and of a 1-room row above maxPricePerOneRoom PLN, and of a row with a known area under minM2PerRoom * rooms (a room in a flat), a 2+ room row with a known area under minM2MultiRoom, and a 2+ room row whose price per room is under minPricePerRoom PLN. medianMinN = owner decision D2 (2026-10-30): a price (hood median, ranking, heatmap bin, API, MCP) is shown only from this many median rows; the heatmap bin counts the rows of its 3x3 block against the same number; a hood with fewMinN..medianMinN-1 rows shows a grey "mało danych" label and no price. hoodMin, rankMinN and bins.binMin are deprecated aliases of medianMinN, kept for one release because old api/mcp builds read this file (the server copies it nightly); nothing in this repo reads them, tests/test_median_min.py keeps them equal. Change a value here only; tests/test_model_constants.py guards the copies.
